params.body:
Intelligence opens the Observatory to read. Goes with the pipeline change of the same name.

- `Offer` defaults: Intelligence gets `observatory`. The Observatory plan's blurb now says it opens what Intelligence opens.
- Each account row for the Observatory's Accounts page carries `observatory`, read from the plan's abilities. The page no longer guesses from the plan name, and it never offers to move a paying Intelligence client to Explore.
- `Plan::firstWith(Observatory)` is now Intelligence. The upgrade hint and the account page name Intelligence for the Observatory, never the unlisted plan.
- MCP contract 3.3.0: `whoami` on a plan below Intelligence lists `not_in_plan.observatory`. This is added only, and noted in docs/mcp-changelog.md.

Full suite 470/472. BuildStampTest fails in a worktree, as on main; McpContractTest passes after the snapshot was accepted with the new version.
params.title: Intelligence opens the Observatory to read
